notes: Both articles of `שֹׁמְרֵי הַבַּיִת` → *the keepers of the house* are placed by rule 29's arthrous count: the ASV writes a *the* before each word, so the present article takes the one before its own word and the construct takes the supplied one. Nothing is fronted.
`אַנְשֵׁי הֶחָיִל` → *the strong men* is the fronting case instead, the rectum being rendered attributively with no determiner of its own, so the article takes the phrase's single *the*.

`בָּאֲרֻבּוֹת` → *out of the windows* retains *out of* as the preposition's two-word rendering, headed on *out* under rule 24. The competing rule 44 reading — *out* as the particle of *look out*, leaving the `בְּ` only *of* — is named in the unit note and remains defensible.
The ASV margin *grinding women* for `הַטֹּחֲנוֹת` is recorded but not aligned, per rule 38.
